class.name: Flock3D
class.brief_description: Native boids flock that animates the instances of its [MultiMesh].
class.description: A flock of agents (birds, fish, bats, insects) steered by the classic boids rules: cohesion, alignment and separation, plus a soft home volume they orbit around. Like Unreal Engine's Niagara boids or Unity DOTS flocking, every agent is written straight into the [member MultiMeshInstance3D.multimesh] instance transforms, so a whole flock costs one draw call and no per-agent nodes or scripts. The multimesh must use [constant MultiMesh.TRANSFORM_3D] and have at least [member agent_count] instances. Agent meshes should face +Z. Positions are local to this node, so moving the node moves the whole flock.

method.name: get_agent_position
method.description: Returns the local position of the agent at [param index].

method.name: scatter_from
method.description: Startles the flock: agents within [param radius] of [param global_point] get a velocity kick of up to [param strength] directly away from it, strongest for the closest ones. Steering then pulls them back together, like birds or fish scattering from a threat.

method.name: step
method.description: Advances the simulation by [param delta] seconds and updates the multimesh. Called automatically every frame while [member active] is [code]true[/code]; call it manually to drive the flock yourself.

members.member: If [code]true[/code], the flock is simulated every frame while visible.
Number of simulated agents. Changing it scatters the flock again around [member home_offset].

How strongly agents steer towards the center of their neighbors.
Local center of the volume the flock circles around.
Agents farther than this from [member home_offset] are pulled straight back.
Distance within which other agents count as neighbors.
Tangential swirl around [member home_offset]. Negative values circle the other way.
How strongly agents avoid crowding each other.

Cruise speed. Agents stay between 60% and 130% of it.
